study type: Retrospective cross-sectional trend study, Retrospective cohort study
outcome: Childbirth interventions (caesarean section rates, spontaneous vaginal birth rates)
cohort: The study included women contacting Spain's first public Midwifery-led Unit between 2017-2022 and childbirth data from all public Catalan hospitals between 2018-2023.
finding: Spain's first public MLU successfully reduced childbirth interventions within the unit and demonstrated a positive 'spill-over effect' on wider hospital practices, with its closure leading to a reversal of these beneficial trends.
mod_finding: Among MLU attendees, 92.3% achieved spontaneous vaginal births and 4.1% had caesareans, while hospital-wide caesarean rates fell from 23.5% to 13.5% and spontaneous births rose to 78.7% during the MLU's operation.
cross-section timing: Childbirth data from 2018-2023 (for cross-sectional trend study); women contacting the MLU from 2017-2022 (for cohort study).
